representation: A_raw frozen ResNet18 source-box features and signed ATP nM predictions
budget: ceil(coverage * study_candidates), identically for every selective method
protocol_A: Historical frozen per-study ceil coverage; 194 of 241 at 0.8
protocol_B: Deployable per-study batch selector with the identical ceil rule; numerically identical to A
risk_evidence: Reuse historical audited strict group-nested OOF residuals and outer-training-selected k/bandwidth
counterfactual: Remove each outer-training source from residual evidence and refit kernel normalization/bandwidth on remaining evidence; retain existing OOF residual values, not ATP predictor deletion/refitting
fallback: If fewer than two remaining sources or rows, remaining residual mean; original outer-training mean only when none remain
objective: minimize maximum source-omission mean estimated error of jointly selected K wells
solver: scipy.optimize.milp / HiGHS, sparse constraints, one thread, mip_rel_gap 0
tie_rule: Lexicographically prefer inclusion by SHA256(2301|well_id); primary cap uses half the declared tolerance as numerical margin
tuning: None on outer outcomes; all six repeatedly examined studies remain exploratory
independence: Technical acquisition studies, not verified independent biological preparations
